stories.title: Federal Reserve raises key rate for first time since 2023
stories.summary: The Fed hiked its benchmark rate a quarter point to about 3.9% to fight stubborn inflation, its first increase in three years. President Trump blasted the board, while higher borrowing costs pressure mortgages, auto loans and credit cards ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: UN experts cite possible US war crimes in Iran strikes
stories.summary: UN-commissioned human rights investigators found 'reasonable grounds' that US airstrikes in Iran, including one on a school in Minab, killed at least 178 civilians. The report said civilians are caught between grave rights violations by their own government and the conflict with the US and Israel.

stories.title: Russian attack on Kyiv region injures at least 19
stories.summary: A Russian missile and drone barrage on Ukraine's capital and surrounding areas injured at least 19 people and damaged dozens of sites. President Zelenskyy said Ukrainian forces struck an oil refinery and a military airfield inside Russia overnight.

stories.title: Carney welcomes proposal for Canada to join EU as associate member
stories.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney told the European Parliament he welcomes the EU's first-ever associate membership proposal, resisting President Trump's portrayal of it as a 'hostile act'. The push draws Ottawa closer to Europe amid deepening trade friction with Washington.

stories.title: Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip to take on Nvidia
stories.summary: Huawei is targeting a Q1 2027 release for its next AI chip, intensifying its challenge to Nvidia amid export restrictions. The move underscores China's push to build a domestic AI computing stack.

stories.title: Base Labs launches open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
stories.summary: AI startup Base Labs announced an open-weight safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire, aiming to bring interpretability research to open models. The collaboration targets transparency and safer deployment of frontier open-source AI.

stories.title: Pinterest teases 'Restyle' feature that redesigns your room with AI
stories.summary: Pinterest previewed 'Restyle', an AI feature that lets users reimagine a room by swapping in different furniture and decor styles. The tool uses the platform's home-decor data to generate variations from a photo.

stories.title: Google, Nvidia and Anthropic back Emerald AI to find grid space for data centers
stories.summary: Google, Nvidia and Anthropic are backing Emerald AI, a startup that helps locate grid capacity for data centers. The effort addresses the power crunch limiting AI infrastructure buildout across the US.

stories.title: B1G Rankings: OSU's standing unclear after messy Week 2
stories.summary: With Ohio State coming off a loss to Texas, Eleven Warriors sorts a muddled Big Ten after Week 2 with little clarity on the conference's best teams. The Buckeyes next host Kent State on September 19.

stories.title: Hamilton denies asking Ferrari to replace staff, concedes title bid is over
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton said he 'never asked for anyone on my team to be replaced' after an Italian report claimed he challenged team principal Fred Vasseur over trackside staff. The Brit admitted his record eighth-title push is finished after retiring from the Spanish GP, trailing Kimi Antonelli by 101 points.

stories.title: Wolff confirms Russell's Mercedes extension is 'already done'
stories.summary: Toto Wolff told Austrian newspaper Oesterreich that George Russell's Mercedes contract renewal is complete despite no formal announcement. Russell sits 81 points behind teammate Kimi Antonelli in the standings after finishing fifth at the Spanish GP.

stories.title: Leclerc hopeful Monza-damaged Ferrari power unit can be saved
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc said Ferrari is still evaluating whether the upgraded power unit damaged in his Italian Grand Prix crash can be reused; if not, he faces a grid penalty. He also flagged a structural one-lap pace deficit in qualifying versus race pace.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: Ohio governor candidate Amy Acton said she is grateful police protected her after Patrick Havas allegedly pushed through a crowd at her Canfield Fair event, injuring people including a trooper. Acton also criticized her opponent for accepting a donation from the suspect's brother.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: The Bexley restaurant district is set to add an outdoor, dog-friendly expansion of The Lion. The project adds outdoor seating to one of Columbus's well-known dining spots.
